scripts.linter:fix: npm run lint && npm run format
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.lint: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run lint -w server" "npm run lint -w client"
scripts.test: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run test -w server" "npm run test -w client"
